q: Ciri umum kemalangan besar (major accident) termasuk:
c: Kejadian tidak terkawal melibatkan kebakaran, letupan atau pelepasan bahan
e: Common features: uncontrolled events, fire/explosion/release, deaths and injuries on/off site, extensive property and environmental damage, from flammable/toxic/explosive substances.

q: Dalam kemalangan Flixborough, punca kegagalan berkaitan penggantian sebuah reaktor dengan:
c: Paip berbentuk 'dog-leg'
e: Flixborough: reactor replaced by a dog-leg shaped pipe.

q: Kemalangan Pasadena (23 Oktober 1989) melibatkan:
c: Pelepasan campuran gas mudah terbakar yang tercetus dan mengorbankan 23 orang
e: Pasadena: release of flammable gas mixture ignited, destroying plant and killing 23.

q: Dalam tragedi Bhopal, berapakah anggaran kematian serta-merta?
c: Lebih 3,500 orang
e: Bhopal: over 3500 people were killed immediately and 170,000 sought medical treatment.

q: Seveso terletak kira-kira 12 km dari bandar:
c: Milan
e: Seveso, 12 km from Milan: uncontrolled exothermic runaway reaction caused a reactor to vent over the town.

q: Yang manakah contoh pemasangan bahaya besar (major hazard installation)?
c: Stor dan terminal LPG
e: Examples of MHI: petrochemical works & refineries, chemical works, LPG storage & terminal, chemical stores, fertilizer plants, explosive factories, water treatment plants.

q: Komponen 'Maklumat tentang Pemasangan' dalam sistem kawalan bahaya besar merangkumi:
c: Reka bentuk, operasi, kajian keselamatan dan penilaian bahaya
e: Information about installation: design, operation, safety study, hazard assessment.

q: Peranan PEKERJA dalam sistem kawalan bahaya besar termasuk:
c: Tidak mengganggu atau mengalihkan sebarang peranti keselamatan
e: Role of workers: cooperate, apply safety instructions, should not interfere with/remove/alter any safety device, notify manufacturer of imminent danger.

q: Peraturan CIMAH diperlukan antara lain untuk mematuhi:
c: Konvensyen ILO berkaitan pencegahan kemalangan industri besar
e: The need for regulations: major accidents worldwide, protect workers, people & environment, comply with ILO Convention, harmonize control system.

q: CIMAH TIDAK terpakai kepada kenderaan atau kapal yang:
c: Mengangkut bahan berbahaya ke atau dari tapak aktiviti industri
w: Diletakkan di tempat letak kereta kilang
e: Part I exceptions: nuclear installation, armed forces installation, vehicle or vessel transporting hazardous substance to/from site, and quantity below 10% threshold.

q: Menurut Peraturan 3 CIMAH, 'bahan berbahaya' boleh berupa semua berikut KECUALI:
c: Bahan lengai (inert)
e: Hazardous substance: very toxic, other toxic, flammable, explosive, oxidising substances.

q: 'Aktiviti industri' di bawah CIMAH merangkumi dua bentuk, iaitu:
c: Proses dan penyimpanan
e: Industrial activity: (a) process – operation in Schedule 4 installation incl. on-site storage/transport; (b) storage of hazardous substances.

q: Pemasangan Bahaya Besar (MHI) ialah aktiviti industri yang mempunyai kuantiti bahan berbahaya:
c: Sama dengan atau melebihi kuantiti ambang (threshold quantity)
e: MHI: quantities equal to or exceed the threshold quantity; NMHI: >10% but < TQ; excluded: <10% TQ.

q: Kewajipan pengilang MHI TIDAK termasuk:
c: Menyediakan pelan kecemasan luar tapak sendiri tanpa pihak berkuasa tempatan
w: Menyerahkan Laporan Keselamatan dan On-Site ERP
Membantu pihak berkuasa tempatan menyediakan off-site ERP
e: Obligation under MHI: notify DOSH, submit Safety Report & On-site ERP, keep up to date, inform local authority, help local authority prepare off-site ERP, inform public.

q: Borang Pemberitahuan Aktiviti Industri dinyatakan dalam:
c: Jadual 5
e: Reg. 7(1)(b): submit the Notification of Industrial Activity Form specified in Schedule 5 to the DG.

q: Selepas menerima pemberitahuan, Ketua Pengarah boleh menentukan sesuatu pemasangan sebagai MHI:
c: Walaupun kuantiti bahan berbahaya di bawah ambang
e: Reg. 7(2)(a): DG may determine installation is a MHI even though the quantity of hazardous substances listed is below threshold; (b) or not MHI.

q: Peraturan 8 CIMAH mewajibkan pengilang memberitahu Ketua Pengarah dengan segera tentang:
c: Sebarang perubahan butiran dalam borang pemberitahuan, termasuk perubahan kuantiti bahan
e: Reg. 8 – Notification of changes: immediately notify DG of any change in particulars, including an increase or decrease in quantity.

q: Laporan Keselamatan (Safety Report) mengandungi maklumat utama berkaitan:
c: Setiap bahan berbahaya, pemasangan dan sistem pengurusan kawalan
e: Main Safety Report contents: (a) every hazardous substance, (b) installation, (c) management system for control.

q: On-site ERP berbeza daripada Off-site ERP kerana On-site ERP:
c: Tidak mengancam komuniti luar dan boleh dikawal oleh pasukan kecemasan tapak
e: Onsite ERP: not a threat to outside community, controlled by on-site team, minimum off-site response, prepared by manufacturer.

q: Komponen On-site ERP termasuk:
c: Ujian berkala peralatan kecemasan, latihan dan latih amal
e: Components of on-site ERP: risk evaluation, organisation & teams, operations manuals, procedures, records, equipment, regular tests, training & drills, review, audit.
